fixes.what: Flat layout. makeRoot no longer copies tcb/scripts into each root: that folder does not exist, and a copy per test case breaks the no-bursts rule. The script now runs as tcb-build/tcb/watch.mjs, found relative to the test file. The intake tests (T18, T19, T21, X6) share one stub folder per file run (tmp/wk-stubs-*), which holds a copy of watch.mjs and lib.mjs plus the seven step stubs and is removed in after(). installStubs marks the root to run that copy and writes only the root's stub-config.json.
Flat layout. The library is now imported from tcb/lib.mjs instead of tcb/scripts/lib.mjs. The script runs as tcb-build/tcb/status.mjs, and the scripts are no longer copied into each root.
Flat layout. The library is now imported from tcb/lib.mjs. The script runs as tcb-build/tcb/handover.mjs, and the scripts are no longer copied into each root.

The script found the intake it spawns and the intake's step scripts through <root>/tcb/scripts/. It now takes both from its own folder (import.meta.url). In the contract layout this gives the same path.

raise's one-line brief named <root>/tcb/scripts/status.mjs as fixed text. It now names the status.mjs beside handover.mjs (from import.meta.url, with forward slashes). In the contract layout this equals the spec's text.

Liveness checks against the process list compared start_time strings exactly. The library now writes a process's own start time from its own clock and compares start times with sameStartTime (CONTRACT 4.4, 4.9), so a real watcher's or alarm's record would never match exactly. aliveIn in both scripts and endturn's watcher.lock vs watcher.json check now use lib.sameStartTime. No test failed on this, because the tests' sleeper records use the PowerShell time.
